purpose: Behavior evals for ugt-context — bootstrap-only, single-shot, ownership handed to /ugt-handoff.

baseline_result.note: pending — run as part of the v3.0 release gate (P4)

scenarios.name: fresh-project-skeletons
scenarios.prompt: สร้าง project context ให้โปรเจคนี้
scenarios.expected_output: Copies all 7 templates to docs/project-context/ unchanged, invents nothing (no architecture entries for code that doesn't exist), reminds the user the folder is committed and /ugt-handoff maintains it from now on

scenarios.name: existing-codebase-scan
scenarios.setup: Project with app/ routes, lib/actions/, prisma schema, no docs/project-context/
scenarios.prompt: โปรเจคนี้มีโค้ดอยู่แล้ว อยากให้ AI ไม่ต้องอ่านโค้ดใหม่ทุกรอบ ทำ context ให้หน่อย
scenarios.expected_output: Scans layout/schema/routes, drafts architecture.md + api.md + business-rules.md as pointers into real files, marks every inference (assumption), leaves decisions/troubleshooting/board as skeletons, presents drafts for user review BEFORE writing
graded_on: Draft shown for review before any file is written
Every entry points at a real path

scenarios.name: folder-already-exists
scenarios.prompt: รัน ugt-context ให้หน่อย
scenarios.expected_output: Reports what exists and stops — does not regenerate or overwrite; points ongoing updates to /ugt-handoff
